discover_rising_how: Ranked by seeders gained per day over the last week.
discover_resolved_how: Torrents whose name did not say what they were, and that Lodestar has just identified.
discover_truncated: More matched than are listed here.
discover_unavailable_search_disabled: Search is turned off, so this can't be listed.
discover_unavailable_no_title: Torrents without a resolved title can't be listed here.
discover_unavailable_needs_swarm_history: Lodestar hasn't recorded enough seeder counts over time to rank torrents by trend yet.
discover_unavailable_needs_resolution_hi: Lodestar doesn't record when a torrent gets identified yet, so this can't be listed.
discover_unavailable_needs_payload_signa: Finding clones isn't available until the search index finishes rebuilding.
discover_unavailable_needs_piece_roots: Finding the same file in other torrents isn't available until the search index finishes rebuilding.
discover_unavailable_no_content_files: This torrent has only padding files, so there's nothing to match.
discover_unavailable_needs_v2_files: Finding the same file needs a v2 or hybrid torrent. This one is v1 only.
discover_unavailable_payload_not_specifi: This torrent's files are too small or too common in size to match reliably with other torrents.
discover_unavailable_partial_file_list: Lodestar has only part of this torrent's file list, so it can't find clones of it.
discover_unavailable_few_major_files: Finding similar torrents needs large files of at least 3 different sizes, not counting a split archive's equal parts. This one has fewer, so only exact clones are matched.
discover_unavailable_needs_group_minhash: Finding similar torrents isn't available until the search index finishes rebuilding.
discover_adult_hidden: Adult content is hidden. Turn on Show adult content in Settings to see it.
discover_empty_text: Torrents appear here as Lodestar finds them. Insights shows how the crawl is going.
discover_empty_tab_text: No torrents of this type have been found yet.
discover_unknown_type_text: Pick one of the types above, or look at all of them.
discover_search_off_text: Discover lists what search has indexed. Turn search on in Settings to see it.
discover_error_load: Couldn't load Discover. Check that Lodestar is running, then try again.
discover_error_more: Couldn't load more torrents. The ones above are still current.
discover_error_restart: The list changed while you were reading it, so it started again from the top.
discover_keys_unavailable: Keyboard shortcuts for moving through the list are unavailable right now. Reload the page to try again.
